items.title: Job document wording
items.note: This app has no job-related workflows.

items.title: Language modes
items.note: English, Hong Kong Cantonese and bilingual modes, saved per computer, in the app and on the website.

items.title: Playfulness sliders and dialog emoji
items.note: Separate English and Cantonese playfulness sliders (1 to 5) change the voice of status, empty-state, toast and error copy. The dialog emoji switch is built. Not every string has five voices yet.

items.title: Personal vocabulary upload
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Drop a vocabulary file onto the app
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: School mode
items.note: Not built yet. Needs the shared cross-app settings record.

items.title: Spoken narrator
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Action sounds
items.note: Short synthesized tones when hosting starts, goes live, stops or fails, with a Settings switch and volume. Visual feedback is complete without sound.

items.title: Scheduled settings
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Rename the app
items.note: Change the name shown in the window title and header; one action restores the shipped name. Data folders and package ids never change.

items.title: Focus modes
items.note: Focus, Low stimulation, Time awareness, One thing at a time and Momentum, each its own switch, all off by default.

items.title: Dim sum surprise
items.note: A 1 in 10 chance at launch of a non-blocking dim sum note with English and Cantonese names. Pictures are not shown yet because the app makes no network requests from its interface.

items.title: Dim sum photo source
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Material Design 3
items.note: Material 3 colour roles, shapes, type scale, navigation rail and bottom bar, generated from one seed colour.

items.title: Workflow navigation
items.note: Five destinations in a navigation rail, a bottom bar in narrow windows, and the current step always visible on Host.

items.title: Motion with a reduced-motion path
items.note: Full, gentle or off, following the system reduced-motion setting. No state is carried by motion alone.

items.title: Live charts
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Per-element appearance editor
items.note: Not built yet. Global appearance settings exist.

items.title: Colour picker
items.note: Seed colour by hue wheel, swatches or hex, with the full scheme regenerated live. Colour-space translation is not built.

items.title: Logo customization
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Overlays and panels
items.note: Notification centre, command palette and confirmations open as layered panels with focus return and Escape.

items.title: Collapsible filters and statistics
items.note: Session filters and statistics fold away and remember their state.

items.title: Accessibility and sizing
items.note: Text size from 90 to 150 percent, comfortable or compact density, visible focus, and layouts tested from 420 px wide.

items.title: Truthful empty states
items.note: No link, count or status is shown unless the backend reported it.

items.title: First-run setup
items.note: Three steps: language and voice, a real Docker and tunnel check, then a short tour. Skippable, resumable, and reopenable from Settings.

items.title: Tabbed navigation
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Regex builder on every search
items.note: Every search box has an adjacent regex builder with flags, live token explanation, match count, validation and a time limit. Full RegexBuddy parity is not built.

items.title: Command palette
items.note: Ctrl+Shift+F opens every destination, action and setting; picking one jumps to it and highlights it. Card or full-window size is remembered.

items.title: Context menus
items.note: Right-click or Shift+F10 opens a menu with a filter field for links, paths, sessions and text. Appearance and lock entries are not built.

items.title: Shortcuts shown in menus
items.note: Menus and the palette show each working shortcut.

items.title: Rich controls
items.note: Values such as the public link and local address carry copy and open controls. Not every value does yet.

items.title: Guided forms
items.note: The project form explains each field and validates the port as you type.

items.title: Info buttons on controls
items.note: Every setting has an info button with an explanation. Worked examples and playgrounds are not built.

items.title: Settings that explain themselves
items.note: Each setting states what it changes and where.

items.title: Presets for blank editors
items.note: The app has no free-form editors.

items.title: Two-key confirmation
items.note: Stopping a live link, clearing history and resetting settings need two separate keys and a slider, with an emergency exit and Escape.

items.title: Element locks
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Support ticket recovery
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Unlock ladder
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Built-in authenticator
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: QR pairing
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Free, no nagging
items.note: The app is free, has no paid tier, ads or upgrade prompts.

items.title: Local version history
items.note: Every hosting attempt and every settings change is kept locally; a settings revision can be restored as a new revision. Encrypted snapshots are not built.

items.title: Export everything
items.note: Sessions as JSON, CSV or Markdown; settings, settings history and notifications as JSON. Archives are not built.

items.title: Bulk actions
items.note: Select many sessions or notifications to export or remove them.

items.title: Changelog viewer
items.note: Every release with date, changes and commit, with date-range filter and regex search. Exporting the filtered view is not built.

items.title: Offline guide
items.note: Every article on the website ships inside the app and opens without a network.

items.title: Rendered provider text
items.note: The app shows no provider-authored rich text.

items.title: Notifications and their centre
items.note: Non-blocking toasts, a searchable notification centre with bulk clear, and errors that stay until dismissed.

items.title: File converter
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Base64 tools
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Minecraft server manager
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Minecraft world generator
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Ollama manager
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Open in an external editor
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Browser download hand-off
items.note: There is no browser extension.

items.title: Publishing to a forge
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Progress and recovery in place
items.note: Progress shows on the step that is running and recovery actions appear on the step that failed.

items.title: Drawing and annotation
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Feature inventory
items.note: This list, with the same honest status in the app and on the website.

items.title: Version and build time on the first screen
items.note: Shows the running version and its build time with seconds and time zone, read from the packaged build record, or says it is unavailable.

items.title: Real screenshots
items.note: Website screenshots are rendered from the real interface with a scripted backend; they are not captures of live hosting.

items.title: Screen recording
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Design reference parity
items.note: The interface follows the checked-in design in design/canvas; a pixel comparison is not automated.

items.title: Design files in the repository
items.note: All design artboards and notes live in design/.

items.title: Clipping checks
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Public screenshot gallery
items.note: Not built yet.

items.title: Material website
items.note: The website carries the feature list, articles, language modes, themes, motion settings, search with regex and the command palette. Not every app feature has a website equivalent.

items.title: Phone-friendly website
items.note: Every website section works from 320 px wide.

items.title: Download button
items.note: Points at the latest published release and shows its version and date when the release exists.

items.title: An article per feature
items.note: Every built or partly built feature links to an article. Planned features do not have articles yet.

items.title: Bundled fonts
items.note: Roboto Flex, Roboto Mono and Material Symbols are copied from npm by scripts/vendor-assets.mjs into the app and the website.

items.title: Link preview image
items.note: The website has Open Graph tags and a preview image.

items.title: Website linked from the repository
items.note: The website is linked from the README. The repository's About field must be set by an owner.

items.title: Private wording boundary
items.note: The app and website are public and have no signed-in surfaces.

items.title: Packaged website for private repositories
items.note: This repository is public.

items.note: Both exist at the repository root.

items.title: Line counts in release notes
